    13	def solve(rows):
    14	    """Return the maximum reward obtainable from nonoverlapping jobs."""
    15	    jobs = sorted((end, start, reward) for start, end, reward in rows)
    16	    ends = [job[0] for job in jobs]
    17	
    18	    # best[i] is the best reward using the first i jobs in end-time order.
    19	    best = [0] * (len(jobs) + 1)
    20	    for i, (end, start, reward) in enumerate(jobs, start=1):
    21	        # bisect only among earlier jobs. An end equal to this start is valid.
    22	        compatible_count = bisect_right(ends, start, 0, i - 1)
    23	        best[i] = max(best[i - 1], best[compatible_count] + reward)
    24	    return best[-1]
